questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Erasmus students at Heidelberg University can rent accommodation through a special channel, which is much simpler than for other students, but you cannot choose where you live.

questions.answer: The university's mensa, Heidelberg University has 3-4 mensas.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Complete the rental application for Erasmus as soon as possible . It is best to complete it on the same day you got the rental application email.

Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: It's quite complicated, and I don't remember all the details, but you need to apply for admission through Heidelberg University's admission system, heico, just like a degree student. Then follow the process on the website. Once you are admitted, you will receive your student account and password via email. At the same time, you will need to set up a VPN and other security systems on your mobile phone and computer in order to access the campus internal network and academic affairs, unless you use the campus's WiFi or computers.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: The education at Heidelberg University is more rudimentary than at KU. The student-to-teacher ratio in economics courses is 50:1 or worse, making it difficult for students to establish close relationships with their teachers, especially if you are seeking additional tutoring.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Heidelberg is very well located. You can take a one-hour train ride to Stuttgart to visit the Mercedes-Benz and Porsche museums, or a two-hour train ride to Strasbourg, France, to visit the old town and the European Parliament.
